notes.title: Tiff and Tussle Release Day
notes.content:
Please enjoy having a bout with the games first finished character, the rabbit. 

As the game progresses we will be listening for feedback on the game for improvements, bug fixes and other features. 

Soon enough there will be more characters, gameplay mechanics and fun to be had, but for now please explore what there is and be sure to reach out if there are any questions or comments.

Hop on!

-Cankerheart
